subjects.title: Welcome & Lesson Overview
subjects.content:
### Welcome to PE!

Today we'll be focusing on **cardiovascular fitness** — what it is, why it matters, and how to improve it.

#### Today's Goals:
1. Understand what cardiovascular fitness means
2. Complete a warm-up routine
3. Learn and practice interval training
4. Cool down safely
5. Reflect on the session as a group

> Make sure you have water and appropriate footwear before we begin!

subjects.title: What is Cardiovascular Fitness?
subjects.content:
### Cardiovascular Fitness

Cardiovascular fitness refers to the **ability of the heart, lungs, and blood vessels** to deliver oxygen to working muscles during sustained physical activity.

#### Key Terms:
- **Heart Rate** — beats per minute (BPM)
- **Aerobic Exercise** — activity that raises your heart rate for an extended period
- **VO2 Max** — the maximum rate of oxygen your body can use

#### Why does it matter?
- Reduces risk of heart disease
- Improves energy levels
- Supports mental health
- Increases endurance

subjects.title: Checking Resting Heart Rate
subjects.content:
### Demo: Finding Your Pulse

Before we get moving, let's establish your **resting heart rate (RHR)**.

#### How to find your pulse:
1. Place two fingers on the inside of your wrist (radial pulse) **or** the side of your neck (carotid pulse)
2. Count the beats for **30 seconds**
3. Multiply by 2 to get your BPM

#### Average Resting Heart Rates:
| Age Group | Average RHR |
|-----------|-------------|
| Children (6–15) | 70–100 BPM |
| Adults (18+) | 60–100 BPM |
| Athletes | 40–60 BPM |

> Write down your RHR — we'll compare it after the workout!

subjects.title: Dynamic Warm-Up
subjects.content:
### Dynamic Warm-Up (5 Minutes)

Let's get the body ready! Follow along with each exercise:

#### Circuit (45 sec each):
1. **Jogging on the spot**
2. **Arm circles** — forward then backward
3. **High knees**
4. **Leg swings** — front/back and side-to-side
5. **Butt kicks**
6. **Hip rotations**

> Focus on controlled movements — this is a *warm-up*, not a race!

subjects.title: Interval Training Explained
subjects.content:
### What is Interval Training?

**Interval training** alternates between periods of high-intensity effort and lower-intensity recovery.

#### Today's Format — HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training):
- **Work period:** 40 seconds
- **Rest period:** 20 seconds
- **Rounds:** 3 sets of the full circuit

#### Benefits:
- Burns more calories in less time
- Improves aerobic *and* anaerobic fitness
- Keeps things interesting!

> Aim to work at **70–85% of your maximum effort** during work periods.

subjects.title: HIIT Circuit Demo
subjects.content:
### Demo: Full Circuit Walkthrough

Before we go full speed, I'll demonstrate each exercise so everyone knows the correct form.

#### The 5 Exercises:
1. **Jumping Jacks** — arms and legs together
2. **Squat Jumps** — land softly, knees tracking over toes
3. **Mountain Climbers** — keep hips level
4. **Push-Ups** — modify on knees if needed
5. **Burpees** — step version available as a modification

> Modifications are always available — listen to your body!

subjects.title: HIIT Circuit — Round 1
subjects.content:
### Round 1 — Let's Go! 

Complete each exercise for **40 seconds**, then rest for **20 seconds** before moving on.

1. Jumping Jacks
2. Squat Jumps
3. Mountain Climbers
4. Push-Ups
5. Burpees

> Push yourself — but stay in control of your movements!

subjects.title: Water Break
subjects.content:
### Water Break — 2 Minutes

Take this time to:
- **Hydrate** — take a good drink of water
- **Catch your breath**
- Walk around slowly to keep blood circulating

> We'll start Round 2 in 2 minutes!

subjects.title: HIIT Circuit — Rounds 2 & 3
subjects.content:
### Rounds 2 & 3 — Keep It Up!

Same format as Round 1. **40 sec on / 20 sec rest.**

#### Round 2:
1. Jumping Jacks → Squat Jumps → Mountain Climbers → Push-Ups → Burpees

#### Short Rest (60 sec)

#### Round 3:
1. Jumping Jacks → Squat Jumps → Mountain Climbers → Push-Ups → Burpees

> Final round — give it everything you've got!

subjects.title: Cool-Down Stretching
subjects.content:
### Cool-Down — Static Stretching (5 Minutes)

Slowly bring your heart rate down with these **held stretches** (30 sec each):

1. **Standing quad stretch** — hold ankle, balance on one foot
2. **Hamstring stretch** — seated or standing toe touch
3. **Hip flexor lunge stretch** — deep lunge, back knee down
4. **Chest opener** — clasp hands behind back, open chest
5. **Shoulder cross-body stretch**
6. **Child's pose** — hold for 60 seconds to finish

> Breathe deeply through each stretch. Never bounce — hold steady.

subjects.title: Heart Rate Check & Reflection
subjects.content:
### Post-Workout Check-In

Let's take our pulse again and compare to our resting heart rate from earlier.

#### Discussion Questions:
- How does your heart rate now compare to your resting rate?
- Which exercise did you find most challenging? Why?
- How does your body *feel* after the session?
- What would you do differently next time?

> Share with a partner first, then we'll open it up to the group.

subjects.title: Partner Fitness Goal Setting
subjects.content:
### Setting a Fitness Goal

With a partner, use the **SMART goal framework** to set one fitness goal for the next 2 weeks.

#### SMART Goals:
| Letter | Meaning | Example |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **S** | Specific | "I will run 3x per week" |
| **M** | Measurable | "For 20 minutes each time" |
| **A** | Achievable | "Starting with a walk/run mix" |
| **R** | Relevant | "To improve my 1-mile time" |
| **T** | Time-bound | "Over the next 2 weeks" |

> Write your goal down — you'll review it at our next session!

subjects.title: Wrap-Up & Dismissal
subjects.content:
### Great Work Today! 

#### What We Covered:
- [X] Cardiovascular fitness fundamentals
- [X] Resting heart rate measurement
- [X] Dynamic warm-up techniques
- [X] HIIT interval training (3 rounds!)
- [X] Safe cool-down and stretching
- [X] SMART goal setting

#### For Next Class:
- Bring your written SMART goal
- Try to do **one active activity** before we meet again
- Optional: track your steps or active minutes

> See you next time — keep moving!
